tagline_withheld.text: RESIDENT FRIENDLY • HOA COMPLIANT • ENERGY SMART
tagline_withheld.reason: 'HOA COMPLIANT' is an unqualified compliance claim. HOA, landlord and building rules vary by association and by property, and nothing in the source material substantiates blanket compliance. Publishing it would also directly contradict the disclaimers this site carries, which tell the shopper to check their own HOA. 'RESIDENT FRIENDLY' and 'ENERGY SMART' are soft marketing and are lower risk.
tagline_withheld.action: The site uses the tagline-free primary lockup. Owner and legal to decide whether to reword (e.g. 'DESIGNED FOR HOA REVIEW'), qualify, or drop the middle claim before the full lockup is used anywhere public.

smart_breaker.when_required: Conditionally required - CraftStrom's own copy: "Use this, if you don't have a dedicated outlet (leading directly to the breaker box without any other outlets)."
smart_breaker.function: Monitors that circuit and turns off Terrace/CraftStrom equipment if combined draw exceeds what's advisable alongside solar input.

power_meter_function.craftstrom_claim: Measures appliance/home power usage in real time so the system can balance solar production with consumption.
power_meter_function.excluded_from_terrace_copy: CraftStrom's own copy pairs this with a 'permit-free' claim - not adopted here; permit status is jurisdiction-dependent and SB 868 is not yet law (see california_regulatory).

requirements: A sunny spot to mount the panels
A designated/dedicated outdoor outlet for the solar kit
Outlets on separate circuits to add Smart Batteries
circuit_requirements.implication: Not accurately described as zero-configuration plug-and-play with no special wiring - there is a real circuit/outlet requirement and conditional Smart Breaker need. Terrace copy should say requirements depend on the circuit, not promise universal standard-outlet compatibility.

sb_868.current_state: NOT LAW. Passed CA Senate 35-1 (2026-05-20); passed Assembly Appropriations Committee 11-0 (2026-08-13); pending full Assembly floor vote (must act by 2026-08-31) and Governor's signature.
sb_868.would_cap: 1,200 W aggregated AC output per dwelling, UL-certified, anti-backfeed required, exempt from interconnection requirements subject to simple online registration
sb_868.publication_rule: Do not publish 'California legal', 'SB 868 compliant', or 'no permit required' language until this is enacted law and matched to Terrace's exact equipment/certifications.

federal_tax_credit.finding: The 30% Residential Clean Energy Credit (IRC Section 25D) expired 2025-12-31 under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. No federal residential tax credit currently applies to a system purchased/installed in 2026.
federal_tax_credit.publication_rule: Do not display any federal solar tax-credit percentage on the site.
